descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S05 Scan in both contexts: every scanned patient is Follow-up, even rows the list marks 'NEW ADMIT' or 'Consult'

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Nothing is ever New Admission (or Consult) unless the physician set it: the app never guesses the status, and a patient nobody has set reads Follow-up (UAT TC-06)
  • U2 Every scanned patient defaults to Follow-up (Hospital census-photo scan and Nursing Home resident-list scan) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician; mocked ai/vision:scanCensusSheet rows (as patient-list-capture.spec.ts does) for a Hospital census with 3 new patients (one row with a status column 'NEW ADMIT', one 'Consult') and a Nursing Home supervisor list with 2 new residents (one marked 'New admit')

When Scan the census from the Hospital list and add all rows; scan the resident list from Nursing Home and add the new residents to Today's Visits

Then Every scanned row with a status word reads Follow-up in its own chart header; neither list shows New Admission or Consult; the scanned residents show on Today's Visits and on All Residents

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 step 1 + TFA-92584 AC 2 (also TC-02 'new patients are added with a Follow-up badge', TC-09). The status is judged in the chart of each row that carries a status word ([selected] option); the list text is a second check, with anchors as in S01. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (scanCensusSheet mocked with 'NEW ADMIT'/'Consult' status rows)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
